Work in /Users/marklevison/Documents/GitHub/expnese-tracker-attempts/yfl-expense-tracker-svelte-generated (SvelteKit 2 / Svelte 5 runes / Supabase / TS, vitest). NEVER run git commit. Code style: tabs, single quotes, no trailing commas, 100-char width. No `any` anywhere including tests. Do NOT edit docs/refactoring-backlog.md. No repo-wide prettier; at the end `npx prettier --write <touched files>` and `npx eslint <touched files>`, fixing eslint errors in files you touch (including pre-existing ones).

Context: the codebase has two service construction patterns. DI via constructor: ExpenseService, CategoryService (`constructor(supabase: SupabaseClient)`). Singletons via `static get()` reaching a module-level Supabase client: ReceiptService (src/lib/services/ReceiptService.ts ~:18), TransactionService (~:20), ReconciliationService (~:28).

Task — RF-07 from docs/refactoring-backlog.md (read the entry): migrate the three singletons to constructor injection, matching the ExpenseService/CategoryService pattern. Remove the `static get()` and module-level client reach; take `SupabaseClient` as a constructor param. Update ALL call sites:
- src/routes/receipts/+page.svelte (~6 sites: `ReceiptService.get().x()`)
- src/routes/reconciliation/+page.svelte (~7 sites: ReconciliationService + ReceiptService)
- src/routes/expenses/+page.svelte (2 sites: ReceiptService)
- src/routes/transactions/+page.svelte (~6 sites: TransactionService)
- Search the whole repo for other `.get()` callers of these services (components, server code, tests) and migrate them all.
In pages, instantiate once (e.g. a module-scope or top-level `const receiptService = new ReceiptService(supabase)`) using whatever supabase client the page already imports — don't create new clients per call. If services internally call each other or the module client for auth, thread the injected client through.

Also update the service unit tests: they may currently inject mocks via the singleton or construct differently — migrate them to constructor injection (this usually SIMPLIFIES the mocking). All existing tests must stay green.

Second small task (WS-1, same file you're already touching): src/routes/transactions/+page.svelte line ~572 svelte-check error `'editRow' is possibly 'null'` — add a guard clause / narrow before use. While in that file, also fix its eslint errors (several `any` types, a mutable `Set` that should be `SvelteSet` per svelte/prefer-svelte-reactivity, `goto()` without `resolve()`, an unused expression) — same for the other three pages you touch: clear their eslint errors too.

Do NOT touch: ReconciliationService.convertToDisplayRows/sortDisplayRows location (a parallel task moves them later — but your DI change to the class is fine), PDFExportService, CategoryService/types Category convergence, CSVExportService.spec.ts.

Verification (must pass):
- `npx vitest run src/lib` (full unit suite for src/lib — all green; note some parser/service specs were just refactored by other agents, run everything)
- `npm run check 2>&1 | tail -3` — report total; the transactions/+page.svelte error must be gone and expenses/+page.svelte must not gain errors beyond its known 2 Category-type errors (a later task fixes those).
- eslint + prettier on touched files.

Return: terse summary — construction pattern applied, call sites migrated per file, eslint cleanups, final svelte-check total, test counts.

content.text:
RF-07 + WS-1 complete.

**Construction pattern (RF-07):** All three singletons migrated to the ExpenseService/CategoryService DI pattern — `private supabase: SupabaseClient; constructor(supabase: SupabaseClient)` with all internal calls on `this.supabase`; `static get()` and the module-level client import removed from:
- `src/lib/services/ReceiptService.ts` (internal `new ExpenseService(...)` for auto-categorization now threads the injected client)
- `src/lib/services/TransactionService.ts` (dropped `private constructor`)
- `src/lib/services/ReconciliationService.ts`

**Call sites migrated (page-level `const xService = new XService(supabase)` using the page's existing client, one instance per page):**
- `receipts/+page.svelte` — 6 sites → `receiptService`
- `reconciliation/+page.svelte` — 7 sites → `reconciliationService`/`receiptService`
- `expenses/+page.svelte` — 2 sites → `receiptService` (removed local `ReceiptService.get()` alias in save handler)
- `transactions/+page.svelte` — 6 sites → `transactionService`
- Repo-wide sweep found no other production callers. Tests migrated to constructor injection: `ReceiptService.spec.ts` (24 sites), `ReceiptService.bulk.spec.ts`, `ReceiptService.split.spec.ts`, `ReconciliationService.spec.ts`, `reconciliation-foreign-currency.spec.ts` (all keep their module mock and just pass the mocked `supabase` in).

**WS-1 + eslint cleanups:** `editRow` null-guard added in the Datepicker `onselect` (svelte-check error gone). Also cleared every eslint error in the four pages and touched specs: 16 `catch (e: any)` → `instanceof Error` narrowing; typed `list()` options in transactions (which surfaced and fixed a real bug — the page sent `includeIgnored` but the service reads `includeExcluded`, so the "Show excluded" toggle never worked; now wired as `includeExcluded: includeIgnored`); `Set` → `SvelteSet` and `URLSearchParams` → `SvelteURLSearchParams`; 9 `goto()`/`replaceState()` calls now use `resolve('/route?query')` from `$app/paths` (kit 2.63 resolve accepts search suffixes; the lint rule only accepts an actual `resolve()` call, not string-concat around it); removed the unused-expression/unused-var effect dependencies (deps now tracked via synchronous reads inside `loadTransactions`/`loadReconciliation`); de-`any`'d `ReceiptService.bulk.spec.ts` with `vi.mocked` + typed mock helpers.

**Verification:** `npx vitest run src/lib` — 1559 passed / 10 skipped, 0 failures. `npm run check` — **2 errors total**, both the known pre-existing Category-type errors in `expenses/+page.svelte` (no new ones); the transactions error is gone. ESLint and Prettier clean on all 12 touched files. Untouched as instructed: `convertToDisplayRows`/`sortDisplayRows` stay in ReconciliationService, PDFExportService, CSVExportService.spec.ts, docs/refactoring-backlog.md.
